name: whisperbox
description: Privacy-first encrypted forms over Waku. Create forms, share a URI/QR, respondents answer end-to-end sealed to the creator only; the creator decrypts, confirms and exports CSV. Pure-QML view over the whisperbox_core module.

provides.description: List my forms (and co-owned ones) with their status and how many answers each has, plus my drafts
Create a form from a template or from questions. By default it becomes a draft opened in WhisperBox for the user to check and publish; publish:true publishes it at once and returns its link

params.name: template
params.description: Start from a template: rsvp, feedback, poll, signup or nps

params.name: title
params.description: The form's title (required without a template)

params.name: questions
params.description: Questions, replacing the template's: [{type: text|textarea|choice|multi|dropdown|yesno|scale|number|email|date, text, options?: [..] (for choice/multi/dropdown), required?: bool}]

params.name: publish
params.description: true = publish now and return the link; default false = a draft to review

provides.description: A summary of a form's answers: per question the counts and percentages (choices, yes/no, scales with average, numbers) and how many written answers there are. Written answers themselves only with includeText, and only if the user agrees in WhisperBox; never who answered

params.name: form
params.description: The form: its title (or a part of it) or its id

params.name: includeText
params.description: Also ask for the written answers (WhisperBox asks the user first)

provides.description: The link to send people so they can answer the form

params.name: form
params.description: The form: its title (or a part of it) or its id

provides.description: Stop accepting answers to a form

params.name: form
params.description: The form: its title (or a part of it) or its id

provides.description: Accept answers to a closed form again

params.name: form
params.description: The form: its title (or a part of it) or its id

provides.description: Show a form (and its answers, if it is yours) in WhisperBox

params.name: form
params.description: The form: its title (or a part of it) or its id
